issues.body: The added text says a sensitive feature appearing in no test:true leg will fail the gate. However, scripts/feature-matrix-tiers.py stores feature_has_test_leg and sensitive_features using only the feature string, not (crate, feature). Cargo feature names are crate-local, so a test:true leg for feature F in crate A can incorrectly satisfy a sensitive F in crate B. This permits exactly the silent coverage gap that the newly graduated documentation claims is prevented.
issues.fix_hint: Change enforcement to key both sensitivity and test-leg coverage by (crate, feature), and add a regression test with two fragments for different crates sharing a feature name where only the unrelated crate has test:true. Then retain the graduation claim once that test proves the guard fails for the uncovered crate-local feature.
issues.title: Mechanized no-test-gap claim is false across crates with same-named features

verdict.summary: The graduation documentation overstates the sq-vya1 guard as fully mechanized. The implementation tracks test coverage by bare Cargo feature name across all crates, so an unrelated test:true leg in one crate can satisfy a sensitive feature of the same name in another crate. Until enforcement is keyed by crate and feature (with a collision regression test), the new authoritative claims are not sound.
